purpose: Separate the rational southward fuel/training concentration of the First Mobile Fleet from any Indian-Ocean commerce raid or Eastern-Fleet reaction.

decision_gate.motive: PASS. Truk is no longer a safe fleet hub, Central-Pacific forward bases have contracted, and carrier-air regeneration/training is urgent after 3-Feb losses.
decision_gate.logistics: PASS_CENTERED. Southern Philippines/Borneo/Singapore-Lingga axis offers better fuel and training support than remaining exposed in the Carolines.
decision_gate.combat_readiness: MIXED. Shokaku/Zuikaku are operational; Hiryu hull/team gate has reopened by early March; air-group cadre depth remains the limiting factor. Taiho is a Branch February-completed hull but remains in work-up and is not counted as an immediate synchronized combat deck.
decision_gate.Eastern_Fleet_motive: NOT_PRIMARY. This is a Mobile-Fleet regeneration/basing move, not a response to INITIAL and not a revival of SA No.1.

04_08_posture.mobile_carrier_scout_screen_pool: Begin movement/planning from Palau-western Philippines toward Davao/Borneo/Singapore-Lingga support axis as maintenance and escorts permit.
04_08_posture.Tone_Chikuma: Remain attached to mobile-fleet scout/screen pool; no Indian-Ocean operational release.
04_08_posture.arrival_guard: Do not claim every named ship has reached Lingga by 8 Mar; exact hull-by-hull transit is not fully reconstructed here.
04_08_posture.Indian_Ocean_effect: Physical proximity may improve in later March, but command ownership and opportunity cost remain; proximity is not sortie authorization.
